atoms.a:
A group of 11 people need to cross a river on a boat. The boat can hold 288 kg.

If 4 people can fit in the boat at once, what is the maximum that each person can weigh?

atoms.b: Each person can weigh a maximum of <mat><gap>72</gap></mat> kilograms.

atoms.b: Each person can take <mat><gap>19</gap></mat> kilograms of supplies.
